correctness.rationale: The first joined-history phrase is necessarily split-source legal; each later phrase crosses the unique reference/target boundary at most once and decomposes into at most two legal phrases. For reference R=a1...am the recursive target T1=R, Tj=Tj-1 (aj...am) Tj-1 has one explicit joined-history phrase per stage. In the separated-source model an exchange lemma justifies longest-match greedy optimality. The unique newly created bigram a_m a_(j-1) in the old target proves each pair of specified factors is maximal; its successor bigram a_m a_j cannot support crossing copies, giving 2m-1 phrases. The universal bound then forces exactly m joined-history phrases. The length recurrence solves to (m-1)2^m+1. Verified by a separate DP for m<=5, greedy families for m<=7 and independent DP on 1764 binary input pairs. Computations do not substitute for the arbitrary-parameter proof.

originality.rationale: The October 19, 2026 Marteau primary source proves only P<=A<=2P and expressly asks in Remark IV.11 whether its multiplier 2 can be attained, reporting a 5/3 observed maximum in small searches. The new result proves P<=A<=2P-1, sharp at every finite joined-history count by a recursive infinite family; unlike a trivial strictness observation it establishes the full sharp ratio function and resolves nonattainment versus sharp supremum. Kosolobov and Shur 2017 derive numerically similar parsing gaps for distinct phrase encodings, not the same fixed-reference boundary model. Targeted published-finding corpus semantic searches and recoverable own claims did not reveal stronger or equivalent coverage. Unindexed priority risk remains.

value.rationale: The 2026 primary source explicitly asks for sharpness of its hybrid-versus-preset-history factor-two comparison. The new bound resolves both aspects: 2 is the least universal multiplicative factor but cannot occur for any finite nonempty target. A constructive exact per-phrase frontier (2-1/m) supplies infinitely many witnesses and explains why short searches saw only 5/3. This is a motivated all-size structural result rather than a parameter substitution or arbitrary finite table.
